protocol.title: Enhancing Protease Activity Assay in Droplet-Based Microfluidics Using a Biomolecule Concentrator
protocol.platform: Integrated nanofluidic biomolecule concentrator + flow-focusing droplet generator (PDMS chip)
affiliations: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, MIT
protocol.objective: Integrate a nanofluidic ICP biomolecule concentrator with a microdroplet generator to enhance sensitivity of low-abundance enzyme assays; detect MMP-9 activity from diluted cellular supernatant with ~10-fold reduction in reaction time and ~100-fold reduction in sample volume

device.fabrication: PDMS chip bonded to PDMS-coated glass slide; soft lithography

concentrator.type: Nanofluidic biomolecule concentrator based on ion concentration polarization (ICP)
concentrator.mechanism: Polymeric nanoporous ion-selective junctions between microchannels; applied voltage drives electrokinetic force opposing pressure-driven flow to trap and accumulate negatively charged biomolecules
concentrator.enhancement_factor_at_encapsulation: ~20-fold (reduced by dispersion during transport and mixing)

droplet_generator.aqueous_surface: Hydrophobic PDMS; aqueous phase lifts off and encapsulates in oil
droplet_generator.surfactant: Biocompatible perfluorinated surfactant (synthesised in-house) dispersed in oil phase

channels.side_channels: Substrate streams (two flanking); merge with enzyme plug at mixing zone just before droplet formation
channels.buffer_channels: Flank main channel on either side of ion-selective membrane for voltage application

mixing.enzyme_substrate_ratio: 1:1 (controlled by flow rates of three aqueous streams)

tracer.name: Alexa Fluor-546 phalloidin
tracer.purpose: Monitor concentration plug in real time; infer local enzyme concentration from fluorescence intensity per droplet

reagents.surfactant: Synthesised biocompatible perfluorinated surfactant in oil phase

substrate.name: FRET-based polypeptide MMP substrate
substrate.readout: Fluorescence increase upon proteolytic cleavage; separate emission channel from tracer

steps.name: Device priming and surface passivation
steps.notes: 2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS; reduces nonspecific adsorption of biomolecules to PDMS channel walls and droplet interfaces

steps.name: Enzyme sample stream preparation
steps.notes: Tracer co-loaded to monitor plug and infer per-droplet enzyme concentration from fluorescence intensity ratio vs. enzyme-free droplet

steps.name: Substrate side-channel stream preparation
inputs: FRET MMP substrate (5 uM in MMP buffer)
steps.operation: dispense into two flanking side channels
steps.notes: Substrate streams merge with enzyme plug at mixing zone; enzyme:substrate ratio 1:1 set by balancing aqueous flow rates

steps.name: ICP biomolecule concentrator -- accumulation phase
steps.operation: Electrokinetic trapping (modelled as heat at 25 C in BioScript)
steps.notes: Electrokinetic force balances pressure-driven flow; negatively charged molecules trapped at depletion boundary and continuously accumulated into plug. Duration is primary handle for tuning enhancement factor. Voltage-off releases plug by pressure-driven flow.

steps.name: Plug transport and substrate mixing
steps.notes: Released plug travels ~200 um to mixing zone; merges 1:1 with substrate from side channels

steps.name: Flow-focusing droplet encapsulation
steps.notes: Gaussian-shaped plug divided into train of droplets spanning range of enzyme concentrations; parallel screening of 0.2-3.2 nM in single experiment. Vortices inside droplets ensure rapid mixing.

steps.name: Droplet incubation and time-lapse fluorescence monitoring (recombinant MMP-9)
steps.readout: Product fluorescence increases linearly with time; tracer channel reports local enzyme concentration per droplet

kinetics.method: Michaelis-Menten; reaction rates vs. concentration from single experiment (Fig. 2B)
kinetics.validation: Consistent with standard plate-reader result and prior MMP literature

steps.name: Cellular supernatant sample preparation
steps.notes: Both conditions co-loaded with tracer; run in sequence on fresh chip

steps.name: ICP concentration of cellular supernatant samples
steps.operation: Electrokinetic trapping (modelled as heat at 25 C in BioScript)
steps.notes: Same ICP conditions as S4. Concentrated samples amplify activity difference between stimulated and untreated ~10-fold relative to unconcentrated.

steps.name: Cellular assay droplet encapsulation and incubation
steps.notes: Concentrated stimulated vs. untreated differentiable within 5 min (line-1 slope 2.14 a.u./s vs. line-3 slope 0.95 a.u./s). Unconcentrated requires >50 min (line-2 slope 0.32 a.u./s vs. line-4 slope 0.22 a.u./s). Fig. 3A.

kinetics.method: Parallel droplets at different concentration enhancements in single experiment (Fig. 3B); linear relation between reaction rate and concentration

key_results.sample_volume_reduction: ~100-fold vs. conventional assays (<25 uL for up to 10 conditions)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Device priming; enzyme stream prep; ICP concentrator; plug release; substrate mixing; droplet encapsulation; MMP-9 recombinant assay

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose assaySignal and tracerSignal; enter cellular supernatant branch

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in s or m (BioScript supports s and m only; no h token)
bioscript_compiler_notes.icp_concentrator_abstraction: Electrokinetic trapping (voltage-on accumulation) modelled as heat at 25 C (room temperature, no external heating). Duration encodes accumulation time controlling enhancement factor. Voltage-off plug release is implicit at end of heat block.
bioscript_compiler_notes.droplet_encapsulation_abstraction: Flow-focusing encapsulation modelled as mix with carrier oil phase. Three droplet concentration bins (high/mid/low) encoded as separate scalar variables representing Gaussian plug division.

compiler_behaviour_notes.drain_lowered_to_dispose: drain statements lowered to dispose at IR level; expected BioScript behaviour
compiler_behaviour_notes.bb5_fall_through: BB5 (pass branch) has no explicit jump in IR; compiler infers edge 5->7 via fall-through. DAG edge present and correct. No source fix required.
